name: N,N-dimethylamphetamine
summary: Dimethylamphetamine (Metrotonin), also known as dimetamfetamine (INN), dimephenopan and N,N-dimethylamphetamine, is a stimulant drug of the phenethylamine and amphetamine chemical classes. Dimethylamphetamine has weaker stimulant effects than amphetamine or methamphetamine and is considerably less addictive and less neurotoxic compared to methamphetamine.

pharmacology.text: It is said to be a prodrug of methamphetamine and amphetamine, which are minor metabolites.

uses.text: Dimethylamphetamine has occasionally been found in illicit methamphetamine laboratories, but is usually an impurity rather than the desired product. It may be produced by accident when methamphetamine is synthesised by N-methylation of dextroamphetamine if the reaction temperature is too high or an excess of methylating agent is used.

summaryZh: 二甲基苯丙胺，也稱為二甲安非他明、N,N-二甲基苯丙胺、N,N-二甲基安非他命，化學類別是苯乙胺類和苯丙胺類興奮劑藥物。二甲基苯丙胺的興奮性作用比苯丙胺或甲基苯丙胺弱，成癮性也顯著降低，神經毒性也比甲基苯丙胺低。然而，它仍然保留了一些輕微的興奮劑作用和濫用潛力，並且在美國、澳大利亞、中國大陸和台灣都是非法的。
summaryZhHans: 二甲基苯丙胺，也称为二甲安非他明、N,N-二甲基苯丙胺、N,N-二甲基安非他命，化学类别是苯乙胺类和苯丙胺类兴奋剂药物。二甲基苯丙胺的兴奋性作用比苯丙胺或甲基苯丙胺弱，成瘾性也显著降低，神经毒性也比甲基苯丙胺低。然而，它仍然保留了一些轻微的兴奋剂作用和滥用潜力，并且在美国、澳大利亚、中国大陆和台湾都是非法的。
